features.name: Dazzling Footwork
features.desc: Without armor or a Shield, your AC = 10 + Dex modifier + Cha modifier. Your Unarmed Strikes deal damage equal to your Bardic Inspiration die (Dexterity).

effect.note: AC without armor = 10 + Dex + Cha (Dazzling Footwork)

features.name: Leading Evasion
features.desc: When you make a Dexterity saving throw to take half damage: on a success, you take no damage; you can use your Reaction to protect an ally, sharing the benefit of Evasion with them.

features.name: Tandem Footwork
features.desc: When you expend a Bardic Inspiration die as a Bonus Action, you move up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and make an Unarmed Strike that deals extra damage.
